items.name: Octopus
items.ask: Who lives in the sea? Can you guess?
items.hint: It has eight long, wiggly arms!

items.name: Crab
items.hint: It walks sideways with two big claws!

items.name: Dolphin
items.hint: It jumps and splashes in the waves!

items.name: Whale
items.ask: Last one! Who is this shadow?
items.hint: It is super big and sprays water up high!

How many did

seo.title: Guess the Sea Animal Shadow! 🐙🐬 Sea Animals for Kids | Shadow Game for Kids | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Can your little one guess the sea animal from its shadow? 🤔 Look, think, and shout the answer with Kiddo!

A quick ocean animals guessing game for kids. Children learn 4 sea animal names:
🐙 Octopus
🦀 Crab
🐬 Dolphin
🐋 Whale

Each round has think time so kids can guess, and a "say it with me" pause to practise new English words. Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for more fun learning games: animals, vehicles, letters, numbers and more!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0)
